_comment: Player skills and perks, read by proto3d/game/perks.gd. Skills grow with use (xp thresholds per level); each level gives the bonus 'per_level'. Perks unlock from reputation and milestones ('needs'); 'effect' values are read by the game systems. Keep numbers small: it's a city game, not a power fantasy.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.text: Sprint longer. Grows while you run.

driving.name: Driving
driving.text: Better grip and steering. Grows while you drive fast.

shooting.name: Shooting
shooting.text: Tighter aim, less recoil, faster reloads. Grows with hits.

strength.name: Strength
strength.text: Harder punches and swings. Grows with melee hits.

swimming.name: Swimming
swimming.text: Hold your breath longer and swim faster. Grows while you swim.

perks.name: Market Mouth
perks.text: You know how to haggle: 15% off at every shop.

perks.name: Keke King
perks.text: Kekes go 15% faster for you, and taxi passengers tip more.

perks.name: Bush Runner
perks.text: 40% more stamina and a little more sprint speed.

perks.name: Cool Head
perks.text: The police lose track of you 35% faster.

perks.name: Roadside Mechanic
perks.text: Press B in a damaged car to patch it up (once every 5 minutes).

perks.name: Big Talk Connect
perks.text: Press B with a wanted level: Big Talk makes a call and two stars go away (once a day).
